description.zh: 小动物有一个原计划（最好的那条路）。走到路口时宣布一个变化：某条路被堵、变难走或变好走，或者能量突然减少。孩子要判断原来的路现在还行不行：行就坚持，不行就换。大约一半的题变化与原计划无关，坚持才是对的，所以“一变就换”和“从不换”都不是策略。选错不判红叉，走过去看结果再调整。K1 路被堵；K2 路变难走或变好走；G1 能量突然减少；G2 两件事同时变。完成即通过，一次想对且没用提示多一个 ⭐，重试、提示和坚持/换路的次数记入报告。
description.en: The animal has a plan (the best road). At the junction a change is announced: a road is blocked, gets harder or easier, or the energy suddenly drops. The child decides whether the old road still works - keep it if so, switch if not. About half of the questions are changes that do not touch the plan, so "always switch" and "never switch" are both bad strategies. A wrong pick is not marked red: walk it, see the result and adjust. K1 a blocked road; K2 a road gets harder or easier; G1 energy drops; G2 two changes at once. Finishing passes, right first with no hints earns a star, and retries, hints and keep/change counts go into the report.

designModel.zh: 主轴是变化的数量（change_count）与类型（change_type：路障、能耗变化、能量减少、组合），配合目标类型（goal_type）和原计划是否仍然有效（plan_status：mixed 表示有的题坚持、有的题要换）。
designModel.en: The primary axes are the number of changes (change_count) and their type (change_type: barrier, cost shift, energy cut, combined), paired with the goal type and whether the plan still holds (plan_status: mixed means some questions need keeping, some changing).

ageRange.noteZh: K1 两条路的简单取舍约 3-4 岁；G2 含隐藏信息与星星权衡约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1 two-route choices suit about 3-4; G2 with hidden information and star trade-offs suits about 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列 · 策略大师。训练的是『情况变了，原计划还有效吗，要不要调整』；与 route-choice 的区别是这里先有一个已知的最好计划，重点是判断变化是否影响它，而不是从零选路。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds · Strategy Master. It trains asking whether the old plan still works when things change, and adjusting only if needed. Unlike route-choice, a best plan is already known and the point is judging whether the change affects it, not choosing a route from scratch.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteEn: How many changes are announced at the junction.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: block 路被堵；cost_shift 某条路变难走或变好走；energy_cut 能量突然减少；combined 两种变化同时发生。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: block - a road is blocked; cost_shift - a road gets harder or easier; energy_cut - energy drops; combined - two changes together.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: least_energy 选最省力；most_stars 在能量内星星最多。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: least_energy picks the easiest road; most_stars earns the most stars within the energy.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: mixed：约一半的题变化不影响原计划（该坚持），其余原计划失效（该换）。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: mixed: about half of the questions leave the plan intact (keep it) and the rest break it (change it).

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 8 题，完成即通过（通过线 75%）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Eight items per run, passing at 75% (6/8). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两条路，一条被堵或变难走：原计划还行吗？
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two roads, one blocked or harder: does the plan still work?

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三条路，有的变难走或变好走：原来最省力的还是它吗？
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three roads, one gets harder or easier: is the plan still the easiest?

levelMap.objectiveZh: 能量突然少了或有路被堵：还拿得到那么多星星吗？
levelMap.objectiveEn: Energy drops or a road is blocked: can you still earn that many stars?

levelMap.objectiveZh: 四条路，两件事同时变了，重新想最好的路。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Four roads and two things change at once: think again about the best road.

statistics.noteZh: 报告 process 带 tiers、retries、hints，以及 keptPlan / changedPlan（本轮需要坚持与需要换路的题数）。
statistics.noteEn: The report process carries tiers, retries, hints, and keptPlan / changedPlan (how many questions needed keeping versus changing).
